choose.when:
SELECT 'COURSE' AS resourceType, c.course_id AS resourceId, c.current_version_id AS versionId, c.course_code AS resourceCode, c.course_name AS resourceName, c.organization_id AS organizationId, o.org_name AS organizationName, c.publish_status AS publishStatus, c.status AS status, TRUE AS executable FROM sts_course_course c JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = c.organization_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.status = 1 AND c.current_version_id IS NOT NULL
AND (c.course_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.course_id DESC

SELECT 'EXAM' AS resourceType, e.exam_id AS resourceId, e.paper_version_id AS versionId, e.exam_code AS resourceCode, e.exam_name AS resourceName, e.organization_id AS organizationId, o.org_name AS organizationName, e.publish_status AS publishStatus, e.status AS status, TRUE AS executable FROM sts_exam_exam e JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = e.organization_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.publish_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RUNNING') AND e.status = 1 AND e.exam_type != 'BANK_PRACTICE' AND e.paper_version_id IS NOT NULL AND e.plan_content_id IS NULL
AND (e.exam_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.exam_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY e.update_time DESC, e.exam_id DESC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT 'QUESTION_BANK' AS resourceType, b.question_bank_id AS resourceId, NULL AS versionId, b.bank_code AS resourceCode, b.bank_name AS resourceName, b.organization_id AS organizationId, o.org_name AS organizationName, b.archive_status AS publishStatus, b.status AS status, TRUE AS executable FROM sts_question_bank b JOIN sts_org_organization o ON o.organization_id = b.organization_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.archive_status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.status = 1
AND (b.bank_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.bank_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY b.update_time DESC, b.question_bank_id DESC
